answer: A new identity serves a probation of 10 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the pearl queue naming the raven that holds the sponsor's bond. As a result, every sock puppet costs 10 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the walnut record shows exactly who is still on probation. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
